name: Campaigns Manager

workflows.CLkKhLzNvwelxxbC: Sync Email Bison Campaigns to Hub

may_change: Hub Campaigns rows: stats and status (the syncs), Stage from Test to Scale or Test to Killed (the manager, never Run); Hub Automations rows: one deploy launch row per in-play campaign with a Live View ID, once a day (the manager's feed lane); DNC rows with Reason Not interested
description: Daily at 11:00 IL and on demand: reads every campaign that is not DRAFT or STOPPED off the Hub, applies standards/campaigns.md (the stage lines, the positives per channel, in play, dry), moves Test to Scale or Test to Killed, feeds every in-play campaign with a Live View ID by creating its deploy row (the door caps the run from the Stage), tags dry, no-view, shared-view and fed campaigns from the deploy rows, shows campaigns without a Stage as NO STAGE, posts one message per client to #flowroots-campaigns, one run row. The syncs keep the Hub true twice a day; Sync Not Interested honors every not-interested reply as a DNC row.
